$comment: SHIPPED, deliberately. The reference implementation this plugin succeeds is FROZEN at v0.11.3 and ships no schemas/gates.json of its own -- it never needed one, because CON-32's reviewer identities lived as a literal in its own gate predicates, not as data. `nen pr ready` never falls back to a built-in reviewer set (a binary that guessed would judge a repository against another one's vocabulary and could report a false ready), so judging a PR in that frozen repository requires --gates pointed at a file carrying those same identities. This is that file: a copy of nen's own shadow-window-validated reviewer-identity fixture (zheref/nen, src/schema/fixtures/bankai-repo/schemas/gates.json), which nen's docs/evidence/shadow-window-p1.md proved byte-for-byte parity against scripts/pr_ready_gate.sh's hard-coded identities across the live estate (16/16, then 17/17 agreement runs). Carried here, in hatsu, as the pr-state skill's --gates argument for that reference repository specifically -- see claude/skills/pr-state/SKILL.md. A repo that ships its own schemas/gates.json needs no --gates flag at all; this file exists only because the reference implementation, being frozen, cannot grow one.

reviewers.$comment: Posts as copilot-pull-request-reviewer[bot]; nothing re-requests it after a final push, so under the bounded policy only a PENDING request owes a round.
reviewers.name: copilot

reviewers.$comment: The check IS the round: it posts a review only when it has findings. The enrolment pattern is ANCHORED and CASE-SENSITIVE on purpose -- a sibling probe job would otherwise enrol the reviewer on every PR. It is not a DEFAULT approver, but it joins the approval set for a PR it has actually posted a review on at head -- the shell's `approvers="$approvers,bisky"` arm.
reviewers.name: bisky

reviewers.$comment: Posts under a login carrying either word depending on the installation, and its check name varies with the installation too -- hence an UNANCHORED, case-insensitive substring where bisky's is anchored.
reviewers.name: bugbot
